title: LinAlg-Bench: A Forensic Benchmark Revealing Structural Failure Modes in LLM Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.16675v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce LinAlg-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark evaluating 10 frontier large language models on structured linear algebra computation across a strict dimensional gradient of 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 matrices. Spanning 9 task types and 660 SymPy-certified problems, the benchmark exhaustively evaluates 6,600 model outputs. Beyond binary accuracy, LinAlg-Bench introduces a three-stage automated forensic pipeline classifying 1,156 failures into ten primary error tags with fine-grained subtypes, revealing that LLM mathematical failure is not random but structurally constrained by algorithm type and matrix dimension. translated_title: LinAlg-Bench：揭示大语言模型数学推理中结构性失败模式的取证式基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了LinAlg-Bench，这是一个诊断性基准，评估10个前沿大语言模型在结构化线性代数计算上的表现，涵盖3x3、4x4和5x5矩阵的严格维度梯度。该基准包含9种任务类型和660个经SymPy认证的问题，共详尽评估了6,600个模型输出。除了二元准确性之外，LinAlg-Bench还引入了一个三阶段自动化取证流程，将1,156次失败分类为十个主要错误标签及其细粒度子类型，揭示了大语言模型的数学失败并非随机，而是受算法类型和矩阵维度的结构性约束。我们的核心发现是在4x4规模处存在一个急剧的行为阈值：低于该规模时，模型通过执行错误而失败——符号追踪失败、算术漂移和奇偶性错误；高于该规模时，失败转变为计算放弃，模型通过工具角色扮演、约束一致的虚构等方式编造响应……
tldr: 该论文提出LinAlg-Bench取证式诊断基准，通过对10个前沿大语言模型在660个线性代数问题上的6,600个输出进行系统性错误分类，发现模型数学失败受算法类型和矩阵维度结构性约束，且在4x4规模存在急剧行为阈值——低于该规模表现为执行错误，高于该规模则转变为计算放弃与编造响应。
en_tdlr: LinAlg-Bench, a forensic benchmark evaluating 6,600 outputs from 10 frontier LLMs on structured linear algebra computation, reveals that mathematical failures are structurally constrained by algorithm type and matrix dimension, with a sharp behavioral threshold at 4x4 scale where failures shift from execution errors to computational abandonment and fabricated responses.
